access_boundary: This record represents the sonar-reasoning-pro line served through the Perplexity Sonar API, the named successor of the December 2025 deprecated sonar-reasoning model. Perplexity ended Sonar Chat Completions support on September 27, 2026: synchronous and streaming requests are being reformulated as Agent API requests, rolling out by model, and the Agent API lists no sonar-reasoning-pro model, only a migration mapping to its low preset. Other Sonar siblings, the Agent API presets, and the platform itself are separate boundaries.
strengths: Dedicated first-party page pins the model with chain-of-thought reasoning and structured outputs
Explicit predecessor-deprecation lineage on first-party docs
tradeoffs: No downloadable weights exist anywhere first-party for this model
The evergreen name carries no pinnable snapshot, and its API support ended on September 27, 2026 with no Agent API model to succeed it, only the low preset
